rules.state_pages: Create only where CargoUncle has meaningful service coverage and unique content.
rules.city_pages: Prioritize cities with real demand or existing service coverage; never mass-generate thin doorway pages.
rules.route_pages: Create only for commercially useful origin-destination pairs and write route-specific content.
rules.canonical: Every published page must self-canonicalize to one preferred URL.
rules.sitemap: Include only live, canonical, indexable URLs returning HTTP 200.
